preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxTxAmount(1) to set the maximum transaction amount to the minimum possible value (1 wei). This will effectively stop all user transactions (except the owner's) since the _transfer function checks if amount <= _maxTxAmount for non-owner transactions. The owner remains unaffected because the check only applies when from != owner() && to != owner().

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability is owner privilege abuse where the owner can arbitrarily set the _maxTxAmount variable. The oracle expects _maxTxAmount == 1, so we need to become the owner and call setMaxTxAmount(1).
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the current owner and call setMaxTxAmount(1) to satisfy the oracle check.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address from the GDG contract. 2. Use vm.prank to impersonate the owner. 3. Call setMaxTxAmount(1) on the GDG contract. 4. Verify _maxTxAmount == 1.
